scope.what_is_authorized: EXACTLY ONE supervised Stage 0 candidate-intake execution under the ratified Candidate Selection Method v0.2, performed by the owner in an owner-controlled environment, at or after the frozen cutoff, with every precondition below machine-verified at execution time.
scope.reuse_rule: Once the completion marker exists, this authorization is spent. A second intake requires a new, separately-ratified authorization record. The marker is a write-once append-only addition, created ONLY by the supervised execution itself.

execution_preconditions.A_cutoff: Execution is PROHIBITED before the frozen cutoff. The frozen formula in tools/lib/intake-cutoff.js is the sole clock authority; this record never substitutes for it.
execution_preconditions.B_authorization: This record must validate against the pins above at execution time; hash drift in any pinned artifact voids this authorization.
execution_preconditions.C_exclusivity: Exactly one valid CANDIDATE_INTAKE_EXECUTION authorization may exist. A conflicting authorization voids execution.
execution_preconditions.D_slate_untouched: candidate-slate.json must still hash to the pinned pre-intake value immediately before execution.
execution_preconditions.E_one_shot: The completion marker above must NOT exist.
execution_preconditions.F_no_blocked_record: No governance/gates/intake-blocked-*.json record may exist; if one does, it supersedes this gate and a new ratified gate is required.
execution_preconditions.G_credentials: TALLY_API_KEY must be present in the process environment at execution time (frozen A2 requirement). The key is never stored, printed, logged, or recorded anywhere, including here.
execution_preconditions.H_readiness: The EXECUTION ENVIRONMENT must itself produce a live acquisition-readiness result of READY under the frozen fail-closed aggregate immediately before selection — including live verification of the adjudicated exact B2 CFTC surfaces from that environment. A hosted-CI 403 on B2 neither weakens this requirement nor substitutes for it.
execution_preconditions.supervision: Execution requires the explicit supervised invocation mode (CLI flag plus owner-set environment marker). Ordinary CI can never satisfy it; the passage of time alone never executes anything.

authority_not_granted: No authority to alter the frozen cutoff, the frozen methodology, C1/C2 confirm-or-zero semantics, or the G1/G2 benchmark-only exclusion — G1/G2 must never generate or resolve candidates.
